A meticulously organized professional composite layout in a 9:16 vertical (portrait) aspect ratio.

All visual content must be created exclusively from the user-uploaded reference images.

The uploaded subject image(s) define every human appearance throughout the layout.

The uploaded product image(s) define every product appearance throughout the layout.

The uploaded background image defines every environmental scene throughout the layout.

Do not invent, redesign, replace, reinterpret, stylize, or generate any new people, products, packaging, accessories, props, logos, branding, decorations, or environments that are not present in the uploaded references.

Preserve the uploaded subject(s), product(s), and background exactly as provided while only reorganizing them into the following layout.

The overall composition is presented on a seamless clean white background with a premium catalog style. Every panel is perfectly aligned with consistent spacing, clean margins, balanced composition, uniform perspective, and unified lighting. Every panel reserves a centered title area for an English label in a clean sans-serif style without requiring readable text generation.

────────────────────────────────────────

Top-Most Row (Hero Figures)

A large bust-up close-up portrait of the uploaded main subject occupies the left panel.

Three smaller full-body views of the same uploaded subject are arranged horizontally on the right, showing:

Front View

Side View

Back View

Every appearance must preserve identical facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, clothing consistency, pose realism, and visual characteristics.

If multiple uploaded subjects are provided, every subject must preserve their own unique identity consistently across all appearances.

────────────────────────────────────────

Middle Row (Product Details)

A perfectly aligned 2×2 grid of equal-sized panels.

Top Left

A macro close-up view of the uploaded Product A.

Top Right

A macro close-up view of the uploaded Product B.

Bottom Left

An alternative view of the uploaded Product A.

Bottom Right

A combined composition showing the uploaded Product A together with the uploaded Product B.

Every appearance of every product must preserve identical:

shape

proportions

color

texture

material

surface details

logos

labels

printing

patterns

geometry

No redesign.

No replacement.

No deformation.

No missing parts.

No additional packaging.

No additional accessories.

No fictional product variations.

────────────────────────────────────────

Bottom Row (Environment & Integrated Application)

Two large environmental panels.

Left Panel

The uploaded background scene with the uploaded subject naturally integrated into the environment together with the uploaded products.

Right Panel

Another viewpoint of the same uploaded background with the same uploaded subject naturally integrated together with the same uploaded products.

The environment must remain visually consistent between both panels.

Only the camera viewpoint may change.

The uploaded products remain visually identical in every appearance.

The uploaded subject remains visually identical in every appearance.

Lighting, shadows, reflections, perspective, scale, and color harmony remain consistent across the entire composition.

────────────────────────────────────────

Global Consistency Rules

Strictly preserve every uploaded subject identity.

Strictly preserve every uploaded product identity.

Strictly preserve every uploaded background identity.

Do not replace any uploaded reference.

Do not hallucinate missing objects.

Do not generate unrelated elements.

Do not merge different products.

Do not merge different people.

Do not alter product proportions.

Do not alter subject identity.

Do not alter the uploaded environment.

Maintain a clean commercial catalog aesthetic with perfectly aligned panels, premium layout quality, high visual consistency, balanced spacing, sharp details, realistic materials, natural lighting, and a seamless professional presentation.

The final result is a clean premium visual layout that reorganizes the uploaded reference images into the specified composition without changing their identity or content.
